summary: The Loudoun Education Foundation urges the FCC to preserve the current scope of the E-Rate program, arguing that narrowing eligibility would shift costs to local taxpayers or classroom budgets. The organization highlights the current eligibility for both Category 1 and Category 2 services and requests that the Commission maintain this level of support.

claims.argument: Narrowing eligibility would shift costs to local taxpayers or classroom budgets
claims.evidence_quote: If that support were narrowed or eliminated, those costs would not disappear. They would shift to local taxpayers or come out of classroom budgets.
